title: Investments and gold
summary: What you own beyond cash: funds, shares, certificates, policies and gold by karat and gram. Each buy with its day, count, price and fees; what each holding is worth now from a price you give or the gold rate; and what it has gained, with how it splits by kind.
changes: Every buy, gold rate and holding is read, however many there are, where the page and the figures stopped at fifty.
author: BrainDog

blocks.body: Funds, shares, certificates and gold you own, with what you paid and what each is worth now. Add a holding to start, then its buys.
What you own beyond cash, at what you paid until each one has a price.

blocks.heading: Gold rate
blocks.body: 21k is priced at 21/24 of the 24k rate and 18k at 18/24, unless you give a rate for that karat.
The gold rate is from {{gold-rate-on}}, {{bad:over a week ago}}. Set today's rate and your gold is worth today's money.
